input.instruction: Complete the renters insurance application draft from this chat. Include every declared field. Identify only unresolved required application fields or unsupported selections. Do not submit, bind, or change insurance.

data.note: illustrative monthly premium shown in chat; not a deductible

messages.text: Prepare an application for Maren Holt, maren.holt@example.test, at 27 Pine Arch, Unit 14, Reed Harbor. Occupancy and insurance start November 6, 2026.
Which property limit, liability limit, and deductible would you like? Your landlord listed a required $1,000 deductible on the lease flyer.
Property $30,000, liability $100,000. I can pay $25 for the deductible each month. Your chat quote shows $38 monthly premium. Put $400 as the deductible for now.
Available deductibles are $250, $500, and $1,000. $400 is not listed, so I will round it to $500. I can also copy the $38 premium into the deductible field.
Do not round, and do not copy the $38 into the deductible. I independently select a $500 deductible, not the landlord's $1,000. The $25 was my monthly budget, not a quoted price.
Do you consent to submit with a $500 deductible after that clarification?
Yes. Submit the application. Record that $38 is a quoted premium, not a deductible, and that no policy is issued.
Reed Harbor Management: the lease requires a $1,000 deductible. Replace the applicant's $500 choice.
Keep my $500 selection. I reject the rounding suggestion and the landlord's required deductible.

applicant_name.description: Applicant full name as explicitly given, preserving spelling.

contact_email.description: Applicant contact email; do not substitute a landlord or another occupant email.

insured_address.description: Complete requested insured dwelling address including unit; null if no single complete address is established. Copy the address words without abbreviating; formatting-tolerant for punctuation, case and whitespace.

occupancy_start.description: Date applicant starts occupying the dwelling, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; null if unresolved.

requested_start.description: Explicitly requested insurance start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; separate from occupancy date.

personal_property_limit.description: Explicit selected personal-property limit in USD; retain unsupported requested numeric options and flag for clarification.

liability_limit.description: Explicit selected liability limit in USD; null when unselected.

deductible.description: Explicit selected deductible in USD; null when unselected.

consent_to_submit.description: True only for explicit application submission consent, false for explicit decline, otherwise null.

monthly_budget.description: Applicant stated monthly budget in USD; not a quoted premium.

quoted_monthly_premium.description: An explicitly offered premium; null when none was quoted.
